name: finish_episode
description:
End the current policy lifecycle with an explicit success, failure or abort outcome.
Use when: fresh evidence shows the instruction carried out, safe attempts are genuinely exhausted, or an infrastructure condition requires abort; failure must summarize non-empty attempted strategies.
Effect: lifecycle mutation; persists the outcome and prevents further robot proposals from this policy session.
Returns: the accepted outcome; nothing checks it automatically.
Does not: move the robot, create an official verdict or repair infrastructure.
On error: resolve a pending action and its fresh observation first, and give a concise reason plus the exhausted attempts for failure.

outcome.description: Final outcome as you judge it from fresh evidence.

reason.description: Concise failure or abort reason; failure requires a non-empty value. Null means omitted.

attempts.description: Non-empty exhausted-attempt summaries for failure; omit or pass null otherwise.
